title: The Bannai-Bannai-Stanton Bound on Distance Sets
abstract: Formalizes the Bannai-Bannai-Stanton theorem: a distance set `S` in `ℝ^d` realizing `s` distinct distances has size at most `Nat.choose (d + s) s`. Follows the short polynomial-method proof of Petrov and Pohoata via a generalized Croot-Lev-Pach rank lemma, with auxiliary results on the diagonal linear-independence argument for polynomials, monomial counting of bounded degree, and a rank bound for sums of matrices.

informal.BannaiBannaiStanton.bannai_bannai_stanto: A distance set `S` in Euclidean space `ℝ^d` realizing `s` distinct distances satisfies `S.encard ≤ Nat.choose (d + s) s`.
